thread:
jenny: Heads-up / SOC2 & ISO fieldwork next week. Auditor asked for a compact evidence bundle: encryption-at-rest proof for S3/EBS/RDS snapshots, KMS rotation history + any DisableKey/ScheduleKeyDeletion events, RBAC change log for production-affecting service principals between 2024-07-01 and 2024-12-31, and a one-paragraph incident triage for the Oct vuln (DEPENDABOT-2024-23). Who can assemble artifacts and map to control refs?

clara: I can take S3 + RDS snapshot exports and produce the manifest. Need confirmation: auditor wants 12 months of history, correct? Also will need a GPG signer for the final tarball.

diego: I can pull EBS snapshot metadata and IAM change events. Commands i'll run (examples):
```
# S3 bucket encryption 
aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket redwood-prod-backups 

# EBS snapshots with KMS ids 
aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:Backup,Values=true --query 'Snapshots[].[SnapshotId,Encrypted,KmsKeyId,StartTime]' > ebs_snapshots.json

# RDS automated snapshots for prod db
aws rds describe-db-snapshots --db-instance-identifier prod-db --snapshot-type automated > rds_snaps.json

# KMS rotation status for all keys
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id {} >> kms_rotation_status.json
```

clara: sample CloudTrail snippet i grabbed for a DB snapshot create: 
```
{ "eventTime":"2024-10-05T12:22:33Z", "eventName":"CreateDBSnapshot", "userIdentity":{ "arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-runner","sessionContext":{"sessionIssuer":{"userName":"backup-runner"}}}, "requestParameters":{"dBInstanceIdentifier":"prod-db","dBSnapshotIdentifier":"prod-db-20241005"} }
```

auditor_mike: Yes, 12 months. Auditor also needs SHA256 hashes + GPG-signed manifest and chain-of-custody notes (who exported which file and when). Also include any iam:PutRolePolicy or iam:AttachRolePolicy events that added s3:PutObject to non-admin roles in that window.

diego: i'll export CloudTrail IAM events for the window and produce rbac_changes_2024.csv (columns: eventTime,eventName,actor,role,resource,comment). Quick highlights from my run: 2024-08-14, iam:AttachRolePolicy, actor=clara, role=svc-analytics, policy=ReadS3Buckets; 2024-11-20, iam:PutRolePolicy, actor=jenny, role=svc-ingest, policy temporarily granted PutObject (policy removed 2024-12-02). I'll include event IDs for traceability.

clara: For KMS: i will pull CloudTrail for KMS:EnableKeyRotation, DisableKeyRotation, ScheduleKeyDeletion, DisableKey and produce kms_audit_events.json. Internal key registry (table keys.kms_rotation_log) has lastRotated dates too. Example row for export: alias/redwood/data, keyId=abcd-1111, rotationEnabled=true, lastRotated=2024-04-21, rotationActor=diego.

jenny: Incident triage (DEPENDABOT-2024-23) summary for the bundle: 
- 2024-10-09: Dependabot alert DEP-2024-23 for vuln in library X detected by automated scans
- 2024-10-10: Triage: severity=medium, exploitability=moderate; assigned to eng-security + infra team
- 2024-10-11: PR #4321 opened to bump X to 2.4.1; code review completed same day
- 2024-10-11 23:50Z: Canary deploy succeeded (job deploy/ci#3321)
- 2024-10-12 02:14Z: Prod rollout completed; post-deploy checks showed no anomalous egress or errors
Artifacts: PR diff, deploy logs (deploy-20241011.log), monitoring summary (mon-summary-20241013.pdf). One-paragraph triage ready and will be included in ir-20241012-summary.txt.

auditor_mike: Good. Map artifacts to controls: SOC2 CC6 (change mgmt), CC7 (encryption), ISO A.9 (access control), A.10 (cryptography). Provide a control crosswalk CSV: artifact,control_ref,proof_location. Prefer single tarball sec-audit-q1-2025-evidence.tar.gz with manifest.csv, bucket_encryption.json, ebs_snapshots.json, rds_snaps.json, kms_audit_events.json, rbac_changes_2024.csv, ir-20241012-summary.txt, and signed hashes. Delivery via presigned S3 link (7d expiry) or secure share.

clara: i'll build the tarball and sign with GPG key 0xC0DEBEEF. Runbook for this export: RB-ENCR-EXPORT-7. ETA: EOD Tue PST. I'll include manifest rows with file path, sha256, exportedBy, exportCommand, cloudtrailEventIds.

diego: i'm dropping interim artifacts under /tmp/sec_audit_upload/ and will hand to clara for final packaging.

audits-bot: Ticket SEC-2025-211 created, owner: clara, due: 2025-03-07, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2025-211

auditor_mike: once uploaded ping me. i'll review and flag any gaps by Wednesday. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
